\section{Blueprint: guarded-collar timeout closeout --- round 15}

\section{Round-15 verdict and changelog (current)}

\textbf{No unconditional closure was obtained. The original physical area seed, P3, CofinalP3, and GoalNeg2 remain OPEN.} Workflow \texttt{\detokenize{wfr_5df3dc43-d69b-4118-bbde-2106f7836520}} failed at its 24-hour total wall-clock limit during Work. Of ten calls, seven succeeded, two earlier failed attempts were successfully retried, and dictionary R2 was cancelled. No closure-verification call was triggered and Blueprint never started. This is a documentation-only closeout, not successful completion of the research workflow.

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{Dictionary: model algebra, not physical identification.} R1 supplies an explicit 16-by-16 companion, inverse, and reciprocal eigenpairs. R2 KData adds four retained explicit-matrix lemmas. \texttt{\detokenize{Q1C10PhysicalDictionary}} and \texttt{\detokenize{physicalLayer}} are compiled definitions; no inhabitant of the physical predicate is supplied.
\item \textbf{Rejected late dictionary evidence.} Stencil has a stale zero marker and a truncated current log with a syntax error at line 993. Support, Transport, and DeepCollar are also not accepted. No physical-row theorem from them is promoted.
\item \textbf{Seed: sharper sufficient interfaces only.} R1 gives charged matrix-leading data; R2 proves the exact two-layer formula and arbitrary-remainder vector limit. No inhabitants of their physical certificates are supplied. The fixed collar-test value \(\sqrt2\) is only a model computation.
\item \textbf{Assembly: weaker premise, conditional conclusion.} R2 proves \(\mathrm{CofinalRadiusChargedLeadingCertificate}\Rightarrow\mathrm{CofinalAreaSeedRightStar}\Rightarrow\mathrm{CofinalP3}\Rightarrow\mathrm{GoalNeg2}\). Only the arrows are proved. No additional vector radius-cofinal goal arrow is claimed, and the larger matrix/vector join is not accepted.
\item \textbf{Numerics: evidence, never a Lean premise.} Exact arithmetic checks all 336 transcribed character blocks; direct sweeps cover q=1,2,4 and even R=18,...,40. Held-out q=1,R=42 runs succeeded at 120 and 155 digits. The q=2,R=42 probe timed out and is excluded. There are no interval certificates.
\item \textbf{Reading classification.} The first-inverse-only all-plaquette reading is \textbf{numerically strongly disfavoured / conjectured false}, not formally refuted and not assigned a probability. The distinct full-guard all-plaquette theorem remains proved. Source-reading questions are not settled by numerics. The open auxiliary refutation does not invalidate the existing Balaban formalisation.
\item \textbf{Complete retained-name inventory.} This addendum has \textbf{101 new accepted declaration nodes, all B} (62 theorems and 39 compiled definitions), exactly matching the parent manifest. It separately adds 8 open assertion nodes, 5 numerical/evidence nodes, 4 rejected-file nodes, and 1 unprinted-helper catalogue node: \textbf{119 new nodes total, 0 new A nodes}. The 101-name count does not include every unprinted helper or inlined historical declaration.
\end{itemize}

The authoritative static evidence is \texttt{\detokenize{AHP/round15/audit/TIMEOUT_AUDIT.json}}, with \texttt{\detokenize{SUMMARY.json}}, \texttt{\detokenize{audit/README.md}}, and \texttt{\detokenize{AHP/round15/shared/GAPS.md}}. The parent parsed complete retained axiom records and checked hashes, source positions, exits, errors, forbidden code tokens, source/log copies, and stale markers. \textbf{This closeout did not independently compile Lean, run numerical solves, repair proofs, or re-audit the inherited Round-14 A/B records.}

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{A --- independently replayed:} inherited only; no Round-15 result is A.
\item \textbf{B --- retained builder compilation:} accepted source/log/exit evidence and a complete individual record using only propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, or a subset. Not independent replay.
\item \textbf{C --- not accepted:} failed, stale, incomplete, or otherwise insufficient current whole-file evidence.
\item \textbf{O --- open assertion:} no inhabitant is supplied. A compiled predicate definition is not an inhabitant.
\item \textbf{N --- numerical/exact-transcription evidence:} no \texttt{\detokenize{\leanok}}; not an interval certificate or physical-operator identification.
\item \textbf{U --- unprinted helper catalogue:} explicit definitions without individual axiom prints; not accepted theorem nodes and no \texttt{\detokenize{\leanok}}.
\end{itemize}

Every accepted Round-15 declaration has its exact name, canonical source line, source declaration header, literal axiom record, and log citation. Repeated R1/R2 prints have one canonical node with secondary locations. Source headers retain section parameters and namespace context; the four q1 lemmas are root-level. Dependencies are named statement/proof inputs at blueprint granularity, not a complete kernel dependency DAG.

\section{Current dependency spine}

The accepted explicit model dictionary leads to an \textbf{open} frozen physical identification, then open exceptional-interface and common mode/observable coordinates, then open nonzero same-generator area and unbounded/cofinal control, and only then the open AreaSeedRightStar. From that input the inherited bp-605 arrow proves P3 and bp-579 proves GoalNeg2. P3 and GoalNeg2 themselves remain open as assertions.

The shortest universal physical input remains \texttt{\detokenize{AdalyFormal.Round14.Transfer.Physical.AreaSeedRightStar}} (bp-602):
\begin{verbatim}
∀ {q R : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hR : 2 ∣ R) (hR18 : 18 ≤ R),
  ∃ u : TwistSpace q R, KernelLine q R (rightStar hq R) u ∧
    ∃ j : ℕ, ∃ hj : j < blockCount q R, areaSum hq hj u ≠ 0
\end{verbatim}
The unit-full-carrier-norm form is equivalent by bp-630. That norm is not the numerical nine-boundary-bond norm. Original P3 and CofinalP3 remain open (bp-557 and bp-580), while bp-579 and bp-583 are proved goal arrows. The physical seed predicates ChargedLeadingData, ChargedVectorData, CofinalRadiusChargedLeadingData, and all nested certificates likewise have definitions but no inhabitants.

The new radius-cofinal route is a \textbf{sufficient certificate, not an equivalence}. At each cofinally selected dyadic scale it requires only cofinally many admissible radii, rather than every even radius. The older all-radius certificate implies it; no reverse implication or physical instance is claimed.

\section{Exact remaining physical work}

\begin{enumerate}
\item Identify the exact frozen flat-collar operator blocks on every required row and Fourier character, not just the explicit model recurrence.
\item Prove the exceptional star and \(\Omega_1\) interface rows.
\item Put the crossing generator, top-row area coefficients, and seed in one finite coordinate system; prove nonzero seed projection and normalized matrix/vector limits, including separate nonvanishing of \(\mathrm{chargedArea}\ K0\ z0\).
\item Establish the same-generator identity with genuine areaSum, at the same physical top row and radius, with full-carrier normalization.
\item Obtain the required all-radius or cofinal/unbounded control. Nonzero z alone does not imply nonzero charged area; scalar decoupling, definiteness, common cell signs, a uniform spectral gap, and invertibility of a naive transfer matrix are not assumed.
\end{enumerate}

\section{Numerical and reading disposition}

R2 verifies characteristic factors and determinant identities for all 336 numerically transcribed character dictionaries. Four malformed q=4 reduced-A fields were repaired only in separate copies; R1 files were unchanged. These are exact computations on transcriptions, not a Lean physical dictionary.

For q=1,2,4 and even R=18,...,40, normalized leading coefficients remain positive and stable. The direct R=40 values are approximately \(0.0133612068931633503479\), \(0.0019184541381844317668645407795820\), and \(0.0001653700585858785228210904209427\). The three-term same-row Laurent fit fails held-out testing; a five-rate fit is diagnostically strong but not exact. No exact physical amplitude or nonexistence conclusion from bounded PSLQ searches is claimed.

Held-out assembly q=1,R=42 runs at 120/155 digits agree with direct normalization and have small reported residuals. They remain finite non-interval evidence. The q=2,R=42 probe stopped after 31 of 64 sectors without JSON or exit marker and is excluded. Accordingly, the first-inverse-only reading is numerically strongly disfavoured / conjectured false. This says nothing against the already-proved full-guard statement \texttt{\detokenize{SolR345Audit.full_guard_literal}} and does not resolve reading-only questions.

\section{Blueprint: the Ginv-only guarded reading — round 14}

\section{Changelog since round 13}

\begin{itemize}
\item \textbf{P3: O → O (unchanged).} No physical area seed, universal detection proof, or cofinal detection family was found. The new area, transfer, cancellation, and path results are conditional reductions or numerical evidence, not a P3 proof.
\item \textbf{GoalNeg2: O → O (unchanged).} No inhabitant of \texttt{\detokenize{AdalyFormal.Round2.Guarded.Pin.GoalNeg2}} is posted. The submitted TailEndpointNegative closure was not accepted as the named main declaration or as a goal bridge.
\item \textbf{New shortest sufficient physical-seed route.} \(\mathrm{AreaSeedRightStar}\Rightarrow\mathrm{P3}\Rightarrow\mathrm{GoalNeg2}\) is compiled. One same-generator nonzero physical areaSum at each admissible instance proves universal original KernelLine detection. The unit-full-carrier-norm form is equivalent; assembly also proves AreaSeedRightStar implies AreaNonvanishing.
\item \textbf{Transfer: 56 new unique declarations.} Exact two-layer/Laurent algebra, explicit quadratic coefficients, normalization, and dominant-limit interfaces sharpen the missing certificate. The frozen recurrence and nonzero physical seed remain absent.
\item \textbf{Cancellation: 26 new unique declarations.} Exact sesquilinear and charged-line scaling, plus conditional dominant-matrix sign control. No definite-Hermitian or common-sign claim is made.
\item \textbf{Path choice: 84 new unique declarations.} Weighted and three-level infrastructure compiles. The modified tail path has a proved negative-pi endpoint (B), while crossing positivity, its kernel package, area seed, detection, and any pinned-goal bridge remain open.
\item \textbf{Assembly: 9 new unique declarations.} One detected generator yields the universal area remainder directly. Added all \textbf{175} new individually axiom-audited round-14 nodes (\textbf{69 A, 106 B}), with every source line and log record checked. No numerical value is promoted to Lean.
\end{itemize}

\section{Verdict and audit boundary}

\textbf{GoalNeg2 remains OPEN. P1 and P2 remain proved; P3 remains the sole original physical input on the right-star route.} The new shortest sufficient input is the still-open existential AreaSeedRightStar (or its unit-norm equivalent), followed by compiled P3 and goal arrows. Neither cofinal noncancellation nor its negation is proved. The modified tail endpoint is not original P1, P3, CofinalP3, or GoalNeg2. This is not a completed guarded refutation.

Notation: \(A=G^{-1}_{\mathrm{all}}\), \(B=G^{-1}_{\mathrm{in}}\), \(D=\Delta^{(2)}_{\mathrm{in}}\), \(C=B-D\), and \(\Theta=A-B\). The intended failure is \(\operatorname{IsUnit}(A)\land\neg\operatorname{IsUnit}(A-D)\). The vacuum singularity used to construct the kernel is \textbf{not} itself the guarded failure point.

The replay source, log and exit were checked; per-node replay citations are supplied. This certifies the displayed statement, not its suitability as a final workflow target. Open physical estimates have no invented theorem names: their Lean annotation points to the existing predicate/operator, explicitly not to a theorem asserting the estimate.

The ledger covers the guarded boundary-response, gap/decay, full-vector/Schur, sign-change, analytic and qualitative routes; the round-10 dictionary/source/jet/hull alternatives; the round-12 star/kernel improvements; the round-13 physical trial, positivity, detection dictionary and repaired integration; and the round-14 transfer, cancellation, weighted/long-path and area-assembly interfaces. Companion wrappers are catalogued separately to retain the historical implications rather than hide stronger premises behind the preferred path. Dependencies are \textbf{named statement/proof inputs at blueprint granularity}, with additional local source references listed; they are not a claimed extraction of Lean's complete kernel-level dependency DAG. Standard Mathlib algebra, topology and finite-dimensional linear algebra, and frozen imported implementation primitives, are the background. A premise occurring in a conditional theorem remains a premise.

Rounds 7 and 11 also contain touching-selector/odd-site and mass-window work for \textbf{different, unguarded pins}. They are not edges proving this Ginv-only target. Round-11 scope nodes below record the relevant outcomes without importing them as guarded counterexamples. No old failed extension is silently promoted from an inherited axiom print.

No Lean compilation, build, reproduction script, numerical solve, source repair, commit or push was run for this documentation task. The source/log audit is read-only. Only the two requested blueprint files are authored in the checkout.

\section{Mathematical spine}

The pinned equivalence reduces the question to the eventual implication
\[
 A\text{ unit}\ \Longrightarrow\ A-D\text{ unit}.
\]
Localized well-definedness supplies the exact correction/pencil identity and the genuine localized inverses. In boundary coordinates it is the comparison of \(K_B=I+\Theta B^{-1}\) and \(K_C=I+\Theta C^{-1}\) on \(\operatorname{ran}\Theta\). Absolute smallness of \(D\) does not control \(K_B^{-1}\); a unit guard is not a uniform gap.

The qualitative refutation route chooses \(\ell=2\), \(a=1\), \(k=1\), \(q=2^j\), and an even \(R\ge18\) \textbf{before} the small-curvature cap. At a vacuum crossing, a first-order correction definite on the full kernel splits the corrected crossing from the carrier crossing. Negating the free interior profile handles either sign. The fully verified round-9 bridge then supplies arbitrarily small-curvature guarded failures with all class, geometry and positive-energy test obligations.

For a physical profile \(f\), define
\[
 z_u=C^2_0(W_0i_Eu),\qquad r_u(b)=\langle E_3,(i_EH_0z_u)(b)\rangle,
 \qquad F_f(u)=2\sum_{p\in\operatorname{plaqIn}\Omega_0}c_{r_u}(p)c_f(p).
\]
These are actual frozen operators, not reduced numerical matrices. The adaptive choice \(f=r_u\) gives curl-square energy. This detects one vector, not automatically an entire kernel. The exact common-profile condition is
\[
0\notin\overline{\operatorname{conv}}\{g(u):u\in\ker A_0(t_*),\ \|u\|=1\},
\qquad g(u)=2\,\operatorname{curl}_P^*\operatorname{curl}_P r_u.
\]
Round 12 proves that under the original whole-kernel charged-line condition this hull is the singleton \(\{g(u_0)/\|u_0\|^2\}\). Round 13 proves that whole-kernel line for every positive q and even R at least 18. Actual detection at the same crossing, or its nested cofinal version, is the remaining original physical obligation.

Round 13 closes the two physical estimates that construct this line: the explicit trial has energy \(-1/4\) at half pi, and on the central-charged-zero subspace the full carrier dominates \(\cos(t)\) times the genuinely positive localized carrier for \(0\le t<\pi/2\). The neutral coordinate is retained. This proves P2 without claiming a strict half-pi endpoint bound or a scale-uniform ordinary-norm gap.

The round-13 detection dictionary proves \(\mathrm{physicalJetAggregate}=\tfrac12\,\mathrm{areaSum}\) for that generator. Round 14 rewrites the same genuine area as
\[
\operatorname{areaSum}(u)=\operatorname{chargedArea}(K,Z_u),\qquad Z_u=g_u+i f_u,
\]
and proves that on one charged real line it scales by \(a^2+b^2\). Consequently one nonzero area on one whole-line generator propagates to every nonzero vector on that line. This is a reduction to one fixed real number per instance, \textbf{not} a proof that the number is nonzero. The matrix \(iK\) is not definite in general, and mixed cell/character signs rule out the naive shortcuts.

The new transfer interfaces permit either an exact three-term Laurent representation or, more generally, a nonzero normalized limit with arbitrary remainder. Neither identifies the frozen right-star flat-collar recurrence or the same-generator observable. The modified three-level path has promising numerical rows and a proved negative-pi endpoint, but its crossing positivity and area seed remain open and no pinned-goal bridge from that path is assembled.

\section{Pinned quantifiers and guards}

The positive target is \texttt{\detokenize{P428Target8SG selAll selAll}}, not a touching-selector target. Its exact order (\texttt{\detokenize{AHP/round3/guarded/pin/Statement.lean:113}}) is
\[
\forall \ell\ge2,\ \forall a>0,\ \exists m_0\ge1,\ \forall m\ge m_0,\ \exists R_0,\ \forall R\ge R_0,
\quad \mathrm{SidePow6}(\ell,\ell^m,a)\ \land\ \exists a_0>0,\ \exists\gamma_0>0,
\]
followed by \textbf{all} depths \(k\ge1\), lattice extents and \(\alpha_0>0\) satisfying \(12\ell^m\alpha_0\le a_0\); then every \texttt{\detokenize{TorusOK}}, \texttt{\detokenize{Admissible}}, \texttt{\detokenize{LambdaOK2}}, and \texttt{\detokenize{ClassCoupled}} instance (with class constant 12 and \(\eta=(\ell^k)^{-1}\)). On each such instance, the sole guard is invertibility of the uncorrected carrier. The conclusion is the coercive inequality for every test satisfying both support conditions. There is no guard on the corrected carrier or corrected constraint inverse.

\texttt{\detokenize{GuardPencilT = GShape CPen}} (\texttt{\detokenize{Statement.lean:133–151}}) keeps the same scale/radius/cap order, with a positive-energy competitor and the uncorrected-carrier guard, and asks for invertibility of \(A-D\). The positive equivalence handles the \texttt{\detokenize{SidePow6}} and coercivity constants; it does not change selectors or interchange the radius and cap. \texttt{\detokenize{GoalNeg2}} is the logical negation of the entire positive target, not one failed numerical instance.

theorem scalar_gap_obstruction (cap : ℝ) (hcap : 0 < cap) :
    ∃ (B D Θ : ℝ), B = 1 ∧ 0 < D ∧ |D| < cap ∧ 3 / 4 ≤ B - D ∧
      Θ ≠ 0 ∧ IsUnit B ∧ IsUnit (B - D) ∧ IsUnit (B + Θ) ∧
      ¬ IsUnit (B + Θ - D) ∧
      0 < |1 + Θ / B| ∧ |1 + Θ / B| < cap ∧ 1 + Θ / (B - D) = 0
\end{verbatim}
\end{theorem}

theorem cofinal_curved_placement_no_separation :
    ∀ m₀ : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, m₀ ≤ m ∧ 1 ≤ m ∧
      ∀ R₀ : ℕ, ∃ R : ℕ, R₀ ≤ R ∧ 17*2 ≤ R*(2^m) ∧
        ∀ a₀ : ℝ, 0 < a₀ →
          ∃ (k : ℕ) (_ : 1 ≤ k) (Lu : PeriodicLatticeExtent) (α₀ : ℝ)
            (_ : 0 < α₀) (_ : (12 : ℝ)*(2^m : ℕ)*α₀ ≤ a₀)
            (_ : TorusOK 2 (2^m) Lu)
            (S : Tower (scaleUp 2 k Lu)) (_ : Admissible 2 (2^m) R k S)
            (Lam : Set (PeriodicLatticeSite Lu)) (_ : LambdaOK2 2 (2^m) R k S Lam)
            (U : LinkCfg (scaleUp 2 k Lu))
            (_ : ClassCoupled 2 (2^m) 12 k S α₀ ((2 : ℝ)^k)⁻¹ U)
            (Bt : Bond Lu → SuTwo),
            OnLambdaTildeIn Lam 2 Bt ∧ OnLambdaT Lam Bt ∧ 0 < bondEnergy Bt ∧
            (∃ e : Bond (scaleUp 2 k Lu), e.1 ∈ S.Om 0 ∧ U e ≠ 1) ∧
            (∃ p ∈ plaqIn (S.Om 0), periodicPlaquetteHolonomy U p ≠ 1) ∧
            (¬ ∃ g : PeriodicLatticeSite (scaleUp 2 k Lu) → G2,
              periodicGaugeTransform g U = fun _ => (1 : G2)) ∧
            ∀ a : ℝ, CPen 2 k Lu (by norm_num) S U a Lam ↔
              IsUnit (dataS selAll selAll (gparams 2 k Lu (by norm_num) S U a Lam)).Ginv
\end{verbatim}
\end{theorem}

theorem full_pair_mass_lower (c s h k l : ℝ) (y z : ℂ)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (hcs : c^2+s^2=1) :

    (c s rest : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (hr : 0 ≤ rest)

\subsection{Detection}

R1 closes the full flat constraint-unit prerequisite and distinguishes linear trace continuation from quadratic detection. R2 supplies the exact global finite mixed-color area dictionary, not a nonzero weighted sum. These detection certificates are builder/publication checked only.

        (vacEdge q R (rightStar hq R))).ker = 2
\end{verbatim}

\begin{verbatim}
theorem areaSum_eq_chargedArea {q R j : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (hj : j < blockCount q R)
    (u : TwistSpace q R) :
    areaSum hq hj u = chargedArea (aggregateCoefficient hq hj)
      (fun e => (realPart (G q R) u e : ℂ) + (imagPart (G q R) u e : ℂ) * Complex.I)
\end{verbatim}
\end{theorem}

theorem vacA_weightedRightStar {q : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q) (R : ℕ)
    (c : Bond (scaleUp 2 1 (dilLu q R)) → ℝ) (a t : ℝ) :
    vacA q R (weightedRightStar hq R c) a t =
      (dataS selAll selAll (gparams 2 1 (dilLu q R) (by norm_num) (dilTower q R)
        (weightedRightStar hq R c t) a (dilLam q R))).Ginv
\end{verbatim}
\end{theorem}

The path infrastructure and conditional tail-area reductions compile. TailEndpointNegative and TailCrossingPositive are only predicate definitions here; the endpoint theorem and crossing package are in the next subsection. Seven historical-namespace support reprints are not new global declaration nodes.

\section{What the proposed failure point actually shows about inverses}

\textbf{There is still no unconditional cofinal failure family.} Conditional on P3 (or CofinalP3), using the now compiled integration, the failure point has the following inverse status:

\begin{itemize}
\item  Object  ---  Status at the conditional guarded failure 
\item  Uncorrected all-plaquette carrier \(A\)  ---  \textbf{A unit.} Its ordinary inverse \(G=A^{-1}\) exists, so the Ginv-only guard is satisfied. The qualitative/profile-reflection route can make this carrier positive definite. 
\item  Uncorrected all-plaquette constraint \(QGQ^*\), used in \(H\)  ---  \textbf{A unit in the admissible small-curvature bridge.} This follows from localized well-definedness and the transfer in Delta2\_lit\_eq\_loc, not from the carrier guard alone. 
\item  Localized base carrier \(B\), corrected localized carrier \(C=B-D\), and localized corrected constraint  ---  \textbf{Units} supplied by localized WellDefAt at the chosen small curvature. The uncorrected localized constraint is also a unit via NG\_unit\_of\_N1. Thus the lift forming D uses genuine inverses. 
\item  Corrected all-plaquette carrier, named G1invS  ---  \textbf{Not a unit:} it is \(A-D\). It has no ordinary inverse. 
\item  Corrected covariance \(G_1\)  ---  It is Ring.inverse of the nonunit above, hence \textbf{zero by totalization}, not an existing ordinary inverse. 
\item  Corrected all-plaquette constraint \(N_1=QG_1Q^*\) and corrected lift \(H_1\)  ---  \(N_1=0\); its totalized inverse and \(H_1\) vanish. The positive-energy competitor ensures the relevant coarse test space is nontrivial, so this zero constraint operator is not an ordinary invertible operator. 
\item  Auxiliary Dirichlet inverse for \(G'\)  ---  Genuine by the dilated Dirichlet-unit theorem. 
\item  Gauge Gram inverse for the projection  ---  Genuine at the flat point and in the sufficiently small curvature neighborhood used by regularity. 
\item  Scalar normalizations  ---  \(\ell=2\) and \(\eta>0\), so these are not singular scalar normalizations. 
\end{itemize}

The exact pencil identity is \textbf{AdalyFormal.D1Residual.G1inv\_lit\_eq\_pencil}, lean/src/DrRed1.lean:52. The totalized collapse is \textbf{AdalyFormal.D1Guarded.genFormS\_collapse\_G1inv}, lean/src/GdGap.lean:56:
\[
\operatorname{genFormS}(B_{\mathrm{test}})=-a\langle B_{\mathrm{test}},B_{\mathrm{test}}\rangle.
\]
Together with an admissible positive-energy test, that collapse defeats a positive coercive lower bound. It refutes the \textbf{carrier-only guarded, totalized formal reading}, if the remaining premise is proved. It is not a counterexample with every printed inverse existing, and it does not refute a version additionally guarded by full all-plaquette WellDefAt.
